energy_anomaly.assessment: Large registry energy separation; the frozen geometry screen passes its listed minimum-distance checks, but the energy gap remains unexplained and must be checked by the higher-mesh comparison. Do not treat it as an established physical ordering.

decision.target_meaning: Provisional targets for higher-mesh registry screening only; not a validated final registry selection.
decision.execution_authorization_note: This review does not supersede AG_SI_REGISTRY_DFT_RELEASE_v2.json, whose phase2_refinement.per_registry_execution_authorized is false and requires a new result-bound release.

release_prerequisites: Before any 8x8x1 run, issue a separate signed release bound to R2 and R1 structure SHA-256, input SHA-256, frozen configuration SHA-256, execution-script SHA-256, environment identity, mesh, MPI/OMP allocation, and REGISTRY_SCREENING_ONLY role.

Correct and test result collection so it obtains the GPAW convergence status through a supported interface; do not access the unsupported ASECalculator.scf attribute. Persist convergence evidence, total energy, force-consistent free energy, all 20 atomic forces, full 3x3 stress, units, and hashes for each registry.

Use a common, explicitly recorded SCF policy for both 8x8x1 targets. Preserve PBE/PAW, 500 eV cutoff, 0.10 eV Fermi-Dirac smearing, fixed ions/cell/registry, and the frozen energy/density/eigenstate convergence thresholds. Any change to scientific or numerical settings requires review and a new bound release.

After results return, compare mesh sensitivity for each target and investigate the R2 energy outlier before claiming a preferred physical registry. No relaxation, d0 scan, or expansion beyond R2/R1 is included in this decision.
non_actions: No DFT was started by this review.
